title.en: Probability models, conditioning, and Bayes' rule
title.zh: 概率模型、条件概率与贝叶斯法则

lead.en: Build weighted probability models, prove event identities, derive Bayes in masses and odds, and diagnose independence, reversed denominators and selected populations.
lead.zh: 建立加权概率模型，证明事件恒等式，以质量及几率推Bayes，诊断独立、反向分母及选择总体。

prerequisites.en: Modules 03 and 05: event sets and counting with explicit uniformity. No calculus or numerical-array package is required for this module.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 03及05：事件集合与明确均匀性的计数。本模块无需微积分或数值数组包。

en: Specify sample spaces, events, masses and probability axioms.
Use inclusion–exclusion, monotonicity and independence-free union bounds.
Derive conditional probabilities, chain rules and total probability with positive denominators.
Compute Bayes posteriors and likelihood-ratio odds updates under explicit rates.
Distinguish disjointness, pairwise, mutual and conditional independence.
Identify selection targets, mixture reversals and the limits of a seeded simulation.
zh: 明确样本空间、事件、质量与公理。
用容斥、单调性及无需独立的并集界。
按正分母推条件、链式及全概率。
依明确率算Bayes及似然比几率更新。
区分不交、两两、相互与条件独立。
识别选择目标、混合反转与种子模拟的边界。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and specify weighted elementary outcomes.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，明确加权基本结果。

text.en: Retrieve event definitions and bound conditions.
text.zh: 检索事件定义与界条件。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and derive both table denominators.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，推两种表分母。

text.en: Enumerate exact masses and pair/triple independence.
text.zh: 枚举精确质量与两两三重独立。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore posterior endpoint cases.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索后验端点。

text.en: Simulate the synthetic model and interpret frequency targets.
text.zh: 模拟合成模型、解释频率目标。

title.en: Selection diagnosis and the complete model

text.en: Repair reversed conditionals, selected dependence and mixture comparison.
text.zh: 修反向条件、选择依赖及混合比较。

text.en: Complete choices and the four-cell written model.
text.zh: 完成选择及四格书面模型。

text.en: Complete the exit task and explain every denominator.
text.zh: 完成结业，解释每个分母。
